theorem: The PSp(4,3) action on the 1080 binary Levi minima has permutation rank 59; the full PGSp action has rank 49. Thus the outer involution fuses ten pairs of PSp stabilizer suborbits. Shared-edge count is only a coarse collapse of a much finer exact orbital scheme.
boundary: Exact bare-GQ(4,2) stabilizer-orbit computation. No representation labels are inferred solely from the subdegrees.
